name: freesolv
preregistration_note: Drafted 2026-10-21 before any run on this dataset; only the file's comment header and first line were inspected. Noise floor, control and baseline come from the cited literature; cf_threshold follows the fixed rule 5/3 x noise floor rounded to 0.1 (ESOL's ratio). The 'calc' column holds computed values and must never be used as the target.

source.citation: Mobley & Guthrie 2014, J. Comput.-Aided Mol. Des., PMID 24928188 (FreeSolv v0.52)

noise_floor_source: FreeSolv assigns a default experimental uncertainty of 0.60 kcal/mol where none is available ('Experimental uncertainty not presently available, so assigned a default value'), per the database file itself.

control.name: polar surface area
control.rationale: 'Hydration Gibbs energy predominantly depends on hydrogen bonding between solute and water molecules'; TPSA is the standard 2D proxy for H-bonding polar surface.
control.ref: Raevsky et al. 2009, SAR QSAR Environ. Res., PMID 19916111; Ertl et al. 2000, PMID 11020286

baseline.text: Molecules containing a hydroxyl group have more favourable (more negative) hydration free energy.
Molecules with at least one hydrogen-bond donor have more favourable hydration free energy.
Molecules with two or more hydrogen-bond acceptors have more favourable hydration free energy.
Molecules with polar surface area above the training median ({value:.1f} A^2) have more favourable hydration free energy.
baseline.ref: Raevsky et al. 2009 (PMID 19916111); Ertl et al. 2000 (PMID 11020286)
